starter_documents.body_md:
# Luma Creator Studio — Demo Profile

> Fictional sandbox data for product demonstration only.

## Audience
185,000 total followers across short-form video and newsletter. Core audience: US-based creative professionals and independent founders aged 24–39.

## Content promise
Practical, calm systems for creative work and sustainable productivity.

## Partnership fit
Strong: creator tools, design software, workspace products, coffee and wellness brands with measurable trial or lead goals.

## Guardrails
No gambling, speculative finance, deceptive wellness, undisclosed sponsorships, or perpetual paid-media usage rights.

# Demo Rate Card and Rights Guardrails

> Fictional values; not a real offer.

- One short-form video: $8,500 base.
- Newsletter integration: $4,000 base.
- Bundle: $11,500 before usage rights.
- Paid usage: priced separately by channel and duration.
- Exclusivity: priced separately and limited to a named category and period.
- Payment: 50% deposit, balance net 15 after approved delivery.
- Two revision rounds included; scope changes require a written change order.

# Partnership Qualification Scorecard

Score each opportunity from 0–5 on audience fit, product credibility, campaign outcome clarity, budget signal, creative fit, rights risk, and delivery feasibility.

Advance only when the opportunity has a score of 24 or higher, no prohibited-category conflict, and a named human next step.

# Campaign Delivery and Recap Checklist

## Before production
Confirm exact deliverables, claims, disclosure, due dates, review window, usage rights, links, and measurement window.

## Before delivery
Obtain Creator approval on the exact assets. Confirm no customer or private data appears.

## Closeout
Record delivery receipt, approval status, payment status, measured results or missing-data note, learning, and recommended next partnership action.

# Relationship Ledger

Use `read_relationship_ledger` before qualifying or following up with a partner. Record confirmed calls, proposals, approvals, delivery receipts, and next actions with `record_relationship_ledger`; preserve a stable identity key and evidence references. Do not treat an unverified lead note as a commitment.

# Finance Ledger

Use `read_finance_ledger` for validated invoices, deposits, payments, refunds, and receipts. Record entries with `record_finance_ledger` and cite the supporting Knowledge invoice, bill, receipt, or agreement. Keep commercial approval separate from bookkeeping or tax advice.

stages.title: Partnership loop completed
stages.author: system
stages.body:
**Goal completed (simulation)**

One creator partnership moved through qualification → Creator-selected opportunity → approved commercial proposal → negotiated rights decision → agreement summary → approved campaign delivery → receipt → recap. The final result and every human decision remain attributable in Workspace Chat.

simulation_experience.completion_summary: The creator partnership demo completes qualification, approval, negotiation, delivery, receipt, and recap inside Workspace Chat. All brands, values, replies, metrics, and receipts are fictional sandbox data; no external system is changed.

expected_baseline.validation_summary: Validated as a deterministic creator partnership sandbox that shows opportunity selection, human approval, commercial negotiation, delivery evidence, receipt, recap, and Goal attribution without external side effects.
validation_evidence: Blueprint v1.1 validation passes with an authored simulation experience.
Every external or financial decision is represented by a Workspace Chat approval or input gate.
Knowledge includes fictional demo context, rate guardrails, qualification criteria, and a delivery checklist.
The final Goal event names the complete opportunity-to-recap chain.
acceptance_criteria: Install in simulation with zero blocking todos.
Walkthrough pauses for opportunity selection, proposal approval, negotiated-rights decision, and exact-delivery approval.
Proposal, agreement, campaign preview, receipt, and recap remain visible in Workspace Chat.
All fictional data and simulated receipts are explicitly labelled.
No brand is contacted and no content, agreement, invoice, payment, or external account is changed.
not_included: No real brand or creator account is connected by default.
No legal advice, contract signature, real invoice, or payment collection.
No invented real campaign performance or payment status.
No external publishing without a promoted live workspace and explicit approval.
